shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: If he does not take bath in cold water,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨ ਜਪੁ ਪੜ੍ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਦਿ ਜੋ ਪਾਵੈ। (੨੫)
verses.translit_en: bin jap paRhe prashaadh jo paavai| (25)

en.bdb: And without reading Jap, takes his food,(25)
Without saying Rehras, passes the evening,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪੜ੍ਹੇ ਬਿਨ ਰੈਣ ਜੋ ਸੋਵੇ। (੨੬)
verses.translit_en: keeratan paRhe bin rain jo sove| (26)

en.bdb: Without reciting Keertan (Sohila) goes to sleep,(26)
Through back-biting if he gets his way through,

verses.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਿਸ ਜਨਮ ਜੋ ਧਰਮ ਬਿਸਾਰੈ। (੨੭)
verses.translit_en: dhirag tis janam jo dharam bisaarai| (27)

en.bdb: Cursed is his birth if he forgets the righteousness.(27)
One who stands not by his words,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਤਿਸ ਠੋਰ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀਂ। (੨੮)
verses.translit_en: kahe gobi(n)dh si(n)gh tis Thor kat naahee(n)| (28)

en.bdb: Says Gobind Singh, he is honoured nowhere.(28)

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਤੁਰਕਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਸ ਜੋ ਖਾਵੈ
verses.translit_en: lai turakan te maas jo khaavai

en.bdb: One who eats meat taken from Turks (Muslims),

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਬਚਨ ਜੋ ਗਾਵੈ। (੨੯)
verses.translit_en: bin gur shabadh bachan jo gaavai| (29)

en.bdb: One who utters any words except the Guru's Shabad,(29)
(One who) listens and concentrates on the Triya Raga,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਹ ਲਾਲ ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਜਾਏ। (੩੦)
verses.translit_en: suneh laal so jam pur jaae| (30)

en.bdb: Listen, Lal Jee, he heads for the domain of death.(30)
